title: Recovery: sessions not cleanly closed last time
description: The child process disappeared along with core's last interruption, and the agent has no memory to auto-resume from — decide one by one whether to continue, take over, rerun, or abandon
crashedWhileMerging: Crashed while merging — git may be in an intermediate state
continueTitle: Reconnect the backend session — the agent remembers prior context
takeoverTitle: Start a new session with a summary injected — the agent's mind is fresh, it has only read the notes
rerunTitle: The worktree must be clean before rerunning
noStatusOutputClean: (no git status output, likely already clean)
confirmDiscard: Discard all uncommitted changes in "{{title}}"'s worktree? This cannot be undone (git reset --hard + git clean -fd).
confirmAbandon: Abandon "{{title}}"? The session will be marked closed, but the task and worktree are kept and can still be handled manually from the task board.

dirtyResolver.heading: The worktree has uncommitted changes — this must be resolved before rerunning:
dirtyResolver.noDiffOutput: (no git diff output — there may only be untracked new files)
dirtyResolver.keep: Keep (create a wip branch and commit)
